name: Islamic Society of Central Jersey
mission: We aspire to be the anchor of a model community of practicing Muslims of diverse backgrounds, democratically governed, efficiently served, relating to one another with inclusiveness and tolerance, and interacting with the neighbors and the community at large in an Islamic exemplary fashion. The fundamental objective of the Society will be to seek Glory to Allah Subhanahu Wa Ta'ala. The Quran, Sunnah and the Sharia shall always be the guiding light for the Society.

rich_narrative.summary: The Islamic Society of Central Jersey provides religious, social, and cultural programming to its local community [4]. However, severe financial transparency and spending efficiency concerns limit its rating [1][3]. No financial filings newer than FY2017 are available — donors should treat this 9-year-old financial picture with caution [3]. In FY2017, the organization reported <cite id="3">$2,240,124 in total revenue</cite>, but directed a program expense ratio of 34.6% toward program costs, which falls significantly below the 75% sector benchmark and peer median of 96.9% [1][3]. On the operational side, the organization maintains direct community services such as <cite id="6">Friday halaqas</cite>, educational programs, and <cite id="8">zakat distribution</cite> [6][8]. It also holds <cite id="1">101.2 months of working capital in cash reserves</cite>, providing extreme financial buffer but raising questions regarding fund utilization [1]. Additionally, governance transparency remains low, with <cite id="3">0 out of 20 BBB Wise Giving Alliance standards met</cite> due to missing disclosure materials [3].
